name: Address fields
summary: Dutch address: first postcode, house number and addition, then street and city. With autocomplete attributes and a postcode check.
avoid: Addresses in other countries: they use a different format.
reactProps: { postcode, houseNumber, addition, additionHint, street, city, postcodeInvalid }
behaviour: The postcode is put in capitals and checked when you leave the field (1234 AB).
You can fill in street and city in advance with a postcode API. That is not part of the component.
a11y: All fields have a visible label and autocomplete, so browsers and password managers can fill them in.
content: Error message with an example: "Enter a postcode like 1234 AB."
do: Only ask for what you need.
dont: House number and addition in one field.
open: Look up street and city with a postcode API.
